R7AG-moose-backcountry-0003.name: 1.6 km SE of Goldeneye Lake
R7AG-moose-backcountry-0003.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AG-moose-backcountry-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Isola FSR (paved road)

evidence.t: 8 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 3.9 ha, right here.
Burn from 2021 (fire G61381), right here: browse.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Finlay River. Closed Year Round. Exemption: Snowmobiles exempt year round (January 1 to December 31). Synopsis map 1-59/23.

plan: Drive: from Bear Lake, about 160 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.78524, -125.17441, pull off on Isola FSR (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 14 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,188 m, about 394 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 120 m N of the spot at 915 m (56.77199, -125.39781). Water: unnamed wetland 110 m SW (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-40, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AG-moose-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-40: about 195 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.03 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
